messages:
sam_csm: Quick flag — Pelican account usage dropped to ~12% weekly active seats, and renewal is 28 days out. Two unresolved tickets are stuck in triage. noticed in the health dashboard this morning.
lee_onboarding: Thx Sam. I see they never completed the advanced onboarding steps (step 4 & 5). Last activity 3 days ago.
maya_success_ops: Adding context — ARR ~$18k, product leads show confusion around config for KV caching. Risk of downgrade if we don't show immediate value. :warning:
sam_csm: Proposed intercept: 1) 15–30m live walkthrough with an engineer within 48h; 2) one-time 2-week burst credit (up to $700) conditioned on attending; 3) quick fixes to the two open tickets before the call. Can we execute?
julian_csm: I can run the walkthrough. Need ENG for screen-share help for the integration. pinging @dev_oncall and @alice_support for ticket pre-check.
alice_support: I can join Tue 11am PT for 30m and will clear the two ticket blockers or at least surface workarounds. I'll prepare a short summary for the call.
lee_onboarding: I'll push a 1-page quickstart (bullet list) into the thread now. Snippet to include: - run model warmup - enable KV cache - set concurrency=4 - sample curl for generate. Example: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-3","input":"..."}'```
maya_success_ops: I'll prepare the credit offer template and attach the conditional terms. Playbook reference: https://redwood.app/cs-playbooks/targeted-credit (use template B).
sam_csm: Owners: julian = walkthrough & follow-up notes, lee = quickstart doc, alice = ticket resolution, maya = finance/credit. Timeline = kickoff within 72h, escalate to renewal call if no response by then. I'll set the CRM flag. :calendar: 
julian_csm: CRM flag set (FLAG-P2-342). Task created: https://crm.redwood.com/t/Pelican-342. Pinged customer via email just now with 2 scheduling options.
ops_bot: Reminder scheduled: \"Pelican walkthrough reminder\" Tue 10:00 PT.
sam_csm: Great — please post a short recap in this thread after the walkthrough with: what we demoed, blockers resolved, next steps, and recommended downgrade mitigation (if any). :thumbsup:
